stable.label: ecosystem-sandbox-rig25-local-tested
stable.note: The ecosystem remains the primary GENESIS experience. The new articulated crab/ragdoll/acoustic layer passed local deterministic tests and is wired on main, but CI and deployed browser/device verification for this layer are still pending.

active_experience.current_change: replace the crab's circle-and-derived-bend presentation with persistent articulated joints/claw tips, slower gait filtering, ragdoll behavior and simulation-driven acoustic events
simulation_changes: each legacy limb receives a persistent added mid-joint Node with terrain collision and distance constraints
crab arm rigs receive persistent dual claw-tip Nodes constrained to the physical hand endpoint
added joints stop receiving authored pose targets after death and continue under gravity/collision/constraints as ragdoll parts
crab desired locomotion speed is low-pass filtered and heavily reduced for slower deliberate movement
crab step phase uses its own slower gait clock instead of the previous fast simTick oscillator
foot-contact, jaw-latch and death transitions generate acoustic events at simulation coordinates
nearby creatures receive distance-attenuated sound memory plus arousal/nerves changes from those same acoustic events
rain and local refined-water state drive procedural ambient WebAudio after user interaction
presentation_and_controls: crab rendering uses a continuous oriented shell silhouette instead of exposing body-node circles
back/front legs are ordered from persistent depth state for a limited 2.5D appearance
wet shell highlight remains tied to local simulated wetness
mobile dock receives a sound toggle when the new acoustic layer is active
existing world-first hideable mobile observer controls remain active
approximations: 2.5D depth state currently affects render ordering/scale only; terrain/body collision is still 2D
the legacy body controller still contains authored direct body drive; locomotion is not yet a pure muscle-force biomechanics solver
added knee joints physically couple to anchor and hand but the original limb endpoint planner is still authored
WebAudio timbre is procedurally synthesized; it is driven by simulation events but is not physically modeled acoustics
V107 bite remains jaw-node to target-node contact threshold rather than tooth-shape penetration/fracture mechanics
corpse scavenging is contact-gated but still lacks stomach digestion
fluid_refinement remains a conservative 2x subcell volume-relaxation approximation, not CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

active_objective: Run CI for rig25_sound, then exercise the deployed ecosystem on iPhone. If stable, deepen one crab further: explicit upper/lower limb lengths, joint limits, contact-force gait and physical ingestion rather than broadening into more cosmetic species.
next_gate: rig25_acoustic can move to CI_PASS only after GitHub Actions runs tests/rig25_sound.test.mjs successfully. LIVE_TESTED still requires the deployed browser route to execute with the new layer and sound unlock behavior.
invariants: The ecosystem sandbox is the primary user-facing experience
2.5D presentation must not be called full 3D physics
Procedural WebAudio must not be called physically simulated acoustics
A visual mouth animation is not proof of feeding
Predator proximity alone must not damage prey
Contact-gated scavenging must not be called digestion
No authored controller may be called learning
CI_PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
